answer: Each identity may endorse only 6 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 1030 aliases need 1030 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. The atlas of the decay is the wall, the wander of the random walk is the audit, and the summit of the distance is public every epoch.
